description: Shows another volume of the open dataset, by the id the dataset tool lists.

id.description: A volume id from the dataset tool.

dataset.description: The dataset now open: its name, root folder, and each volume's id, label, shape and spacing, with the one shown marked.

useWhen: Step through the runs or modalities of the open dataset.

avoidWhen.when: The volume is not part of the open dataset.

effects: Reloads the viewer: overlays added by an agent, the crosshair and the plane start over.

failures.meaning: The id is not one of the open dataset's volumes.
failures.remedy: Call dataset and use one of the ids it lists.
